themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are intensifying demands for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to public services, housing, and social benefits. This theme has seen strong convergence in Spain, Italy, Poland, Argentina, and France, with parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Prawo i Sprawiedliwość, La Libertad Avanza, and Rassemblement National leading the charge.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands national priority in housing, social aid, and public services, accusing the government of favoring foreigners over Spaniards.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Advocates for policies that prioritize Italian citizens in employment and social benefits, aligning with anti-immigration rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Promotes 'Poland first' policies, emphasizing national sovereignty and opposition to EU migration quotas.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Proposes economic and social policies that prioritize Argentine citizens, often criticizing foreign influence and immigration.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Pushes for strict immigration controls and policies that prioritize French citizens in access to jobs, housing, and welfare.

themes.title: Trump-Meloni diplomatic fallout escalates
themes.blurb: The diplomatic rift between former U.S. President Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has intensified, with cross-border coverage highlighting the personal and political tensions. This theme has resonated strongly in the U.S., Italy, France, and Spain, with far-right parties and media outlets amplifying the narrative of strained transatlantic relations.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's criticism of Meloni over Italy's refusal to support U.S. military actions against Iran has dominated right-wing media coverage.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government faces scrutiny over its handling of the diplomatic spat, with opposition parties questioning Italy's stance on U.S.-Iran tensions.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella have weighed in on the dispute, often siding with Meloni and criticizing Trump's rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Spanish far-right media has framed the dispute as a broader critique of U.S. influence in Europe, aligning with anti-globalist narratives.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right and right-wing parties in Europe and the Americas are grappling with internal divisions, with leadership struggles, policy disagreements, and public infighting dominating recent coverage. This theme has seen strong convergence in Italy, Germany, Argentina, Sweden, and the UK, reflecting broader challenges to party cohesion.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Internal tensions between Meloni's faction and hardliners like Roberto Vannacci, who has launched a rival political movement.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Power struggles within the AfD, including leadership changes and allegations of extremist ties, have weakened party unity.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Public infighting between factions led by Karina Milei and Patricia Bullrich over government policies and leadership roles.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Internal power struggles and leadership challenges have raised questions about the party's future direction.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage's leadership faces scrutiny over undeclared donations and internal party disputes, threatening Reform UK's stability.

themes.title: Judicial and corruption scandals in far-right governments
themes.blurb: Corruption scandals and judicial investigations are plaguing far-right governments and parties, with allegations of financial misconduct, illicit enrichment, and abuse of power dominating recent coverage. This theme has seen strong convergence in Argentina, Spain, the U.S., Poland, and Hungary, reflecting broader concerns about governance and accountability.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Manuel Adorni faces allegations of illicit enrichment and asset laundering, with opposition parties pushing for his removal.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Accusations of financial mismanagement and misuse of public funds, including transfers to the Disenso Foundation.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Ongoing investigations into Trump's business dealings, including allegations of financial misconduct and obstruction of justice.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Allegations of corruption and abuse of power in Warsaw hospitals, with opposition parties demanding investigations.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Detentions and investigations into misuse of public funds, including the NKA scandal involving former Fidesz officials.

themes.title: Far-right leaders celebrate Colombia's election
themes.blurb: Far-right leaders in the Americas and Europe have celebrated the election of Colombia's far-right president, Abelardo De la Espriella, framing it as a victory for conservative and nationalist movements. This theme has seen moderate convergence in Argentina, the U.S., Spain, and France, reflecting shared ideological alignments.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei has praised De la Espriella's victory, framing it as a triumph for libertarian and anti-leftist movements.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump and his allies have celebrated De la Espriella's election, emphasizing shared anti-socialist and pro-business policies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Spanish far-right media has framed De la Espriella's victory as part of a broader right-wing resurgence in Latin America.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella have expressed support for De la Espriella, aligning with his anti-immigration and nationalist policies.
